end.summary:
Discussed that keeping school clean, green and safe is everyone’s shared job.
Sorted wet waste into the green bin and dry waste into the blue bin.
Explained that vegetable peels and dry leaves can go into compost, with air and some dampness.
Explained that wrappers and foil do not rot and should not go into compost.
Child’s final teach-back was incomplete.
end.parentNote: Anika practised shared responsibility for school cleanliness, waste sorting, and how compost needs suitable wet waste, air, and dampness. They first mixed up wrappers but corrected this later by explaining that plastic and foil do not rot in compost. At home, ask Anika to sort a few everyday items into wet and dry waste and explain why.
